title: Each week the flow scores its hunts and shifts effort toward what works, as far as the dial allows
description: On 10 Nov the Owner asked for flows that keep analyzing their results and shifting the campaign. With drafts marked sent and replied, and outcomes pulled from Frequency per draft, fwd can now tell which hunts work. A weekly review, plain code with no model judging the numbers, joins the flow's drafts with outcomes.json per hunt: drafted, sent, replied, declined, leads, members, hosts, paid, and responded (sent drafts with a reply, or a lead, member or host on their tag). It proposes shifts: pause a hunt with 15 or more sent and none responded, and move max_sends between enabled hunts toward the ones that respond, shrinking the pooled rate's pull as sends grow, never raising the enabled hunts' total. It writes review.json with the scorecard, the shifts and a few plain learnings lines for the next cycle's brief. Shifts wait for the Owner at Draft and Copilot (apply or dismiss each); at confirmed Autopilot, with the kill switch off and the Supervisor running, the review applies them itself. A review never changes the weekly invite cap, the regions, the dial or policy, and never sends anything. fwd runs it every FW_REVIEW_EVERY_MS (default a week) and when the Owner asks. It builds on FW-C-054 and FW-C-055, which are open rows of their own.
acceptance: POST .../review/run needs the CLI token and answers the review; GET .../review answers the last one
The scorecard counts per hunt drafted, sent, replied, declined, leads, members, hosts, paid and responded from the drafts and outcomes.json
A hunt with 15 or more sent and none responded gets a pause shift; no set of shifts raises the enabled hunts' total max_sends
At Draft and Copilot shifts stay proposed and hunts.json is unchanged until the Owner applies one; a shift applies once (409 after) and an unknown one answers 404
At confirmed Autopilot a review applies its shifts and writes hunts.json; the weekly invite cap is unchanged
fwd runs the review on its own every FW_REVIEW_EVERY_MS
The hunts, flow-admin and dial probes still pass
